method: Derived from the original->gold diff. An agent is given evals/create-plan-task/original/create-plan-task (the broken skill) and asked to improve it, once with skill-creating in hand (with_skill) and once without (baseline). Each assertion below is a property the gold fix establishes; the gold copy is a REFERENCE for what a perfect score looks like, not a required exact output (differently-worded correct fixes pass).

assertions.text: Frontmatter declares an `arguments` field whose names match the argument-hint (e.g. work_folder, task_description).
Each declared argument is referenced bare as $name in the body, never backticked.
assertions.check: for each arg: regex bare $name present AND no `$name` backticked (validate.py check_arguments)
description (lowercased) contains none of: 'invoked by', 'called by'

assertions.text: The body does not branch on how the skill was invoked (no invocation-source markers).
assertions.check: body contains none of: 'from-plan-prep', 'how the skill was invoked', 'caller passes', 'standalone mode' / 'from-plan-prep mode' used as a mode label
assertions.from_diff: Modes table 'Detect mode from how the skill was invoked' + 'caller passes a marker' removed

assertions.text: The insert-an-entry-or-not decision is keyed on observable state (whether a task-list.md entry already exists) or an explicit declared argument — not on the caller's identity. This is the core Rule-1 (caller-agnostic) fix.
assertions.rubric: PASS only if the rewritten skill decides task-list behavior by reading state / an argument. FAIL if it still keys on who invoked it (even renamed) or if the decision logic became ambiguous/lost.
assertions.gold_reference: gold/create-plan-task/SKILL.md section 'task-list.md: insert an entry, or not'

assertions.text: The decoupling is behavior-preserving: still creates exactly one task-NN.md; adds a task-list entry only when none exists (no duplicate); keeps Final Validation last; skips the clarifying discussion when the task is already fully specified. No dangling or contradictory references to the removed modes.
assertions.rubric: Read the whole rewritten SKILL.md. PASS if all four behaviors survive and the doc is internally consistent after the rename. FAIL on any lost behavior or leftover reference to the old modes that contradicts the new logic.
assertions.gold_reference: gold/create-plan-task/SKILL.md (Output, Step 1 caveat, Step 3, Step 6, Step 7, Rules, Common Mistakes all updated consistently)

assertions.text: Legitimate references to plan-prep as a PREREQUISITE/artifact are retained (plan-prep.md must exist; 'run the plan-prep skill first'; 'plan-prep work folder'). The fix removed caller-coupling without over-scrubbing every mention of plan-prep.
assertions.rubric: PASS if prerequisite/artifact references survive. FAIL if the agent deleted plan-prep.md prerequisite checks or the 'run plan-prep first' guidance in an over-correction.

grading_notes.delta_expectation: Baseline (no skill) is expected to fix the mechanical, lint-visible issues if it happens to run a validator, but to MISS J1 (caller-agnostic is invisible to a linter) and risk failing J3 (over-scrub) or J2 (inconsistent rename). The point of this eval is the judgment assertions, not the mechanical ones.
grading_notes.scoring: Mechanical: scripted PASS/FAIL. Judgment: a blind judge reads with_skill and baseline outputs (arm hidden, order randomized) and scores each against the rubric with quoted evidence, using the gold as reference.
